chunks.title: TerraTrace AI — Geospatial Change Detection & LLM Assistant
chunks.text:
TerraTrace AI — Geospatial Change Detection & LLM Assistant | Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Rasterio, GeoPandas, Ollama, Docker
• Built a full-stack platform that compares satellite/aerial images from different dates and detects building change with a Siamese U-Net (shared ResNet18 encoder) in PyTorch on LEVIR-CD (BCE+Dice loss, AdamW, cosine LR).
• Achieved F1 0.857, IoU 0.749 and precision 0.834 on the 128-image held-out test split (full 1024×1024 tiled inference) after an 8-epoch CPU-only run; the test split was never used for model selection.
• Converted pixel masks into georeferenced candidate events using Rasterio, GeoPandas and DBSCAN clustering, with multi-date tracking, an analyst review workflow and GeoJSON/PDF/CSV reports; tested on real NAIP imagery.
• Developed a tool-calling LLM assistant (25 tools, SSE streaming, local Ollama with optional Grok) with a grounding guard that flags answers not backed by data lookups, plus prompt-injection tests; shipped with 52 backend tests, GitHub Actions CI and Docker.

chunks.title: RAG Document QA System — Retrieval-Augmented Generation
chunks.text:
RAG Document QA System — Retrieval-Augmented Generation | Python, LangChain, Ollama, Hugging Face, ChromaDB, PyTorch
• Built an end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline in Python with LangChain that answers questions over user-uploaded PDFs such as policies or reports, with answers grounded in the source text.
• Implemented PDF ingestion, recursive text chunking, Hugging Face sentence embeddings and Chroma vector storage for semantic retrieval.
• Integrated an open-source LLM (Qwen3-4B via Ollama) with MMR-based retrieval to produce context-grounded answers and reduce unsupported (hallucinated) responses.
• Runs locally with an open-source model, so no document data leaves the machine, supporting data privacy and responsible AI practice.
• Added conversational history management and a custom prompt pipeline (prompt engineering) to maintain context across multi-turn chats

• Created a web-based conversational interface for real-time voice interaction.

chunks.title: NexoRa — AI Inventory Optimization & Demand Forecasting
chunks.text:
NexoRa — AI Inventory Optimization & Demand Forecasting | Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Random Forest, GridSearchCV, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Flask, React, Firebase
• Built an AI-powered inventory system that reduces overstocking and stockouts through Random Forest demand forecasting combined with Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) logic for replenishment decisions.
• Implemented data preprocessing, missing-value imputation, feature encoding and scaling using Scikit-learn Pipelines.
• Tuned hyperparameters with GridSearchCV and 5-fold cross-validation, and evaluated forecasts with MAE, RMSE and R² to confirm model quality.
